summary: Fixture clients can reply to threads and link asks as declared fixture agents through the normal bound-agent authorization path.

rules.detail: Production authorization is unchanged. Only the fixture executable installs local declared-agent attribution in test-support builds.

compatibility.detail: Reuses the existing local identity header and BoundAgent provenance; ordinary executable and paired transport behavior are unchanged.

manual.detail: Fixture clients select an agent declared in the fixture; undeclared agent identities are refused.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores person-only fixture attribution without changing stored data.
